title: Test inheritance-to-delegation preserves super-init inputs

notes:
Safety valve activated after three materially unchanged repository-gate attempts.

Expected behavior:
- When replacing inheritance with delegation, constructor inputs passed through super().__init__(...) reach the delegated object at the original evaluation point.
